design.headline: The boards
design.lead: The global design sets the tone; each moment of the weekend has its own board, with rental and stationery details. Every board exports to a PDF signed with the house's mark.

workflow.title: Approval workflow
workflow.blurb: When a board moves to “To review”, the client receives an email notification. They approve or comment directly on the board; you are notified of every response.

docs.title: Automatic document analysis
docs.blurb: Drop a vendor proposal, contract or invoice: the agent extracts the amounts, schedule and terms, updates the budget and sets the payment reminders by email.

internal.title: Behind the analysis
internal.blurb: Your notes, negotiation margins and method live here. The agent draws on them to answer the client in your name — without ever revealing them.
internal.placeholder: A margin, a method, a thing to keep quiet…

vendors.headline: Vendors
vendors.lead: Each talent's curation, followed end to end — with every proposal, contract and invoice in its place.

reading.title: Document reading
reading.blurb: Drop any vendor document — proposal, contract or invoice. The agent identifies its type, extracts amounts, schedules and terms, and feeds the budget automatically.

outreach.blurb: Availability request, proposal request, negotiation, confirmation — pre-written per vendor category, sent from your inbox via Netlify Forms.

process.headline: The Madame Wedding Design process
process.lead: What will happen, in the order it will happen — so every step feels inevitable, never a surprise.

phases.title: Listening.
phases.body: We learn who you are, what this wedding should tell, and set the scope budget.

phases.title: Design.
phases.body: The global creative direction, then a board for each moment — from welcome to farewell.

phases.title: Production.
phases.body: Vendor curation, contracts, stationery, logistics. You approve, the house orchestrates.

phases.title: The wedding days.
phases.body: The house is on site, from the first arrival to the last departure.
